verdict.rationale: The evidence implies data portability without documenting an export path. MotherDuck runs on open-source DuckDB, works from the standard DuckDB CLI, SDKs and a Postgres-compatible endpoint, and supports a local-first workflow. DuckLake can also be built on your own files or your own cloud object storage, which keeps data in storage you control. However, no evidence explicitly documents exporting a full MotherDuck database to open formats (e.g., Parquet/CSV) or a migration-off path, and the upload docs only cover moving data in. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all databases to named open file formats, download of the cloud database back to a local DuckDB file, an offboarding/migration guide, and independent confirmation that a full exit works in practice.
